overall_notes: The paper focuses on controllable alignment of LLMs for multi-objective optimization (3H: helpfulness, honesty, harmlessness) using a novel CPO method. Evaluation is primarily done through LLM-as-judge (GPT-4) with scaled scoring and supplementary human evaluation. No traditional automatic NLG metrics are used.
